status: pre-registered 19 Nov 2026, while study_v2 was still in its coarse round (R1) and before any session-2 prediction of any study was opened; design choices confirmed by the user. Later changes go to a 'deviations' list in this file with what had been seen.
kind: exploratory follow-up of study_v2; separate from study_v2's confirmatory families, which it does not change
motivation: study_v2 R1 (coarse round, seed 0, session-1 validation nMAE on D24 common targets, best config per cell): carry_2s 0.0191, carry_5s 0.0213, carry_10s 0.0239; best reset-window cell w20_o50 0.0216, w20_full 0.0224. Carried state got worse as the chunk (truncated-BPTT length) got longer, and 2 s was the shortest chunk study_v2 tests.
seen_at_registration: study_v2 R1 validation scores of every cell except the 50- and 100-sample 75 % overlap cells (not finished); no R2, R3 or final run; no session-2 prediction.

questions.Q1: Do carried-state chunks shorter than 2 s (1, 0.5, 0.2 s) predict session 2 better than 2 s?
questions.Q2: At equal gradient look-back (0.2 s), does carrying the state beat resetting it each window: carry_0.2s vs w20_full?

runs_after: study_v2's final runs and its confirmatory analysis are complete; never at the same time as study_v2 runs
search: the same as study_v2 for every follow-up cell: R1 = the 6 shared draws + the anchor (the same configs as study_v2's carried-state cells, since draw_seed is the same); R2 = 4 fine draws around the cell's best R1 config; R3 = best 2 of R1 + R2 get seed 1, winner by paired 1-SE; every round under study400

references.rule: reused from study_v2, not re-run: the final runs (seeds 10-12) of study_v2's cell winners FE_cell_carry_2s and FE_cell_w20_full, scored by the same code

decision_rule: study_v2's: per comparison, an effect counts only if all 6 people agree in sign and the median effect is at least 5 %; otherwise 'no clear difference'. Each comparison is scored on the samples both of its arms predict, as in study_v2.
descriptive: session-1 validation nMAE of the best config against chunk length over 0.2, 0.5, 1 s (this follow-up) and 2, 5, 10 s (study_v2)
weight updates per epoch and run time per cell
session-2 nMAE against time since trial start for carry_2s and w20_full (the warm-up question study_v2 validation cannot answer); changes no choice
not_tested: update frequency separately from gradient look-back (e.g. 2 s look-back with an update every 0.5 s): considered and left out to keep the follow-up small and the training code unchanged

budget.check: after the follow-up's R1, from measured run times only (as study_v2's budget check)
budget.rule: add fallback steps in order until the projection fits; if it still does not fit, stop and ask the user

implementation: not written at registration: study_v2's code paths (ML, EXPERIMENTS/pipeline|protocol|tuning) must not change while it runs. After study_v2 ends: load this file as a second protocol, write its specs with the TS3_ prefix and its results to EXPERIMENTS/results_followup, and score it with study_v2's confirm code. No other setting may differ from study_v2.
limitations: Chosen after seeing study_v2 R1 validation results: an exploratory follow-up, reported as such, not as part of study_v2's pre-registered comparisons.

The follow-up runs after study_v2's session-2 results are known; every choice inside it uses session-1 validation only, and its comparisons and decision rule are fixed here, before any session-2 prediction was opened.
The references are reused runs from study_v2, made with the same code and protocol, at an earlier date than the follow-up's runs.
